verdict.rationale: A probe found an official Drata MCP server documented in Drata's help center (help.drata.com/en/articles/13379899). The developer portal also advertises letting AI agents interact with Drata and manage controls through natural language, so the core story is delivered. missing for 10: details on MCP tool coverage, auth/setup steps for connecting an agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works.
